The task says group multi-valued parameters INTO modes - each pool value assigned to exactly one mode where possible. So:
- 4 wavelength triplets → 4 modes (CWDM ch 1271, 1291, 1311, 1331)
- 8 host/media combos → 8 modes

These are different dimensions. The application table is the primary "selectable configuration" - **8 modes** with host/media/frame/standards/bit_rate/fec from each row. Wavelength values 4 triplets all apply to the same product - assign all 4 triplets to the same group of modes = each of 8 modes needs all 4 triplets.

- 8 host interfaces → 8 modes

Not a perfect partition unless we have 8 modes and wavelength values repeated (each value in multiple modes) - grouping isn't necessarily a partition.
